text:
anita: Hey infra team — can someone take a look at PR #4321? It touches GPU pool TF module: enabling AZ affinity and changing route propagation. I think plan is ok but want a second pair of eyes before I merge. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321

jeff: dropping by — can you paste the plan snippet?

anita: sure, here are the relevant lines from `terraform plan`:
```
  # module.gpu_pool.aws_subnet.selected[0] will be updated in-place
  ~ resource "aws_route" "natgw_route" {
      + destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
      + gateway_id             = "nat-abc123"
      ~ route_table_id         = "rtb-xyz" -> "rtb-xyz"
    }
  # module.gpu_pool.aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer will be created
  + resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
      + id = (known after apply)
    }
```

sam: VPC peering creation is expected — which AZs are we pinning affinity to? could cause uneven GPU distribution.

anita: setting `az_affinity = true` and `preferred_azs = ["us-west-2a","us-west-2b"]` in the module vars. This flattens GPUs into two AZs for better cache locality.

zainab: FYI please hold merge until canary is exercised in dedicated staging. Last time a route change caused traffic blackholing for a few minutes. Can we run canary deploy and smoke tests first? :exclamation:

infra-ci: build status: ✅ all checks passed (unit/format/plan checks)

oncall-bot: Compliance scan: missing tag `billing:team` on new VPC peering resource — failing policy. (rule: required-tags)

jeff: ah, the compliance bot — that's why I asked. If it's just tagging we can add `tags = { billing = "ml-infra" }` in the peering resource. Anita, can you add and re-run plan?

anita: yeah will add tag and run plan. Also I'll hold the merge and add a comment: `DO NOT MERGE until canary smoke tests pass`.

sam: if we need a quick rollback command, keep this handy:
`# rollback: terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool -var 'az_affinity=false'` — or `terraform state rm aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer` if creation stuck.

zainab: thanks. I can run the canary around 14:30 PT and verify smoke. Please ping me when it's ready. :thumbsup:

jeff: I'll take a proper review in ~30m. If anything looks off ping me directly.

anita: appreciated — holding and will update PR shortly. Thanks all!
